headline: The newest story appeared in 0 of 25 answers.
description: A self-initiated study: what AI assistants associate with Insta360 across 25 stored answers, what the brand can substantiate, and what is missing.
hubTeaser: Five bare prompts, five repetitions, human-reviewed descriptions. Independent study; Insta360 was not a client.
cardFooter: MEASURED / DIRECTIONAL · FULL CONDITIONS IN THE STUDY
hubSummary: We asked AI to describe Insta360 25 times. The newest story the brand tells about itself never came up once.
